finding: Eight rounds' findings were structural; the record was rebuilt rather than patched.
answer: Shape NEGOTIATION with BONDAGE (sides, leverage, objections, revealOrder, deadline, aftermath, bondageSheet, costToTheBound). The broker obeys no one's word: he comes to the house himself and ends his own claim by a release he speaks before witnesses, the way an Owing ends (L2, L3, QA13), when two of his three objections are answered by leverage the player gathered (the survivor's refusal, the Reed's coin, the courier). Five working stages, none hollow (the dream, 50, is a sneak-past whose failure throws the dreamer back): 10 alchemy, 20 restoration or persuade and present-evidence, 30 bargain or persuade, 40 persuade, settle-an-owing and intimidate. Stage 35 is gone (Nesh-Deeka's death goes on to the meeting; 92 reads either way). Facts added: fact.mq03.cord-woman, fact.mq03.jar-rings (the phial), months-witnessed, survivor-refuses, broker-claim, courier-lever, reed-purse, release-witnessed. Each conclusion has three clues that do not hang on which survivor MQ01 saved (c1: camp, phial, Nesh-Deeka; c2: broker, Nesh-Deeka, Salts-The-Catch). The Reed is still first named at 30 by the player's own reasoning (R6-1, R7-2 kept). Endings now cost the bound: whose months, the player's or the survivor's.

finding: Eight rounds' findings were structural; the record was rebuilt rather than patched.
answer: The charge is a keeper's failure throughout (t5, fact.mq04.naming-due, stages 20 and 60), which is what custom's award, an apology and a season's work, answers (L4, L9). Pays-Late hid the cut because it was sealed with his own gum (t4, fact.mq04.minder-hid, c3), and left his workshop unbarred (fact.mq04.workshop-unbarred, the grey part). The hearing opens only at the laying (daysSince event.mq04.laying 3, said at stages 10 and 20) or when the player comes to the fence holding the jars or a bound man; the naming topic is granted only at 60. The workshop zone is gone: stage 20 needs the cut root and the leech (alchemy) or the egg-tender (persuade); stage 30 needs the night watch (timeOfDay night, the stair zone, the tree-minder at mark.mq04.cut-root) or present-evidence to him, gated on the leech or the egg-tender. The verdict needs two signs, one the jars or a bound man (shapeData.accusation); a bound man without handing is e-kept (96). The camp is enabled at stage 10 so the world does not wait. A dead root-herald at stage 10 goes to 95. c2 has three clues in three forms; c3 is new.
